text: This paper proposes video diffusion models: a standard diffusion process on a fixed block of frames, using a space-time factorized 3D U-Net that turns each 2D convolution into a space-only 3D convolution, keeps spatial attention over space, and inserts temporal attention with relative position embeddings after each spatial attention block. [@chk-e097b566e01ffd0fec3adf37] For longer or higher-resolution video, it uses reconstruction-guided sampling: an adjusted denoiser that adds a reconstruction-error gradient on the conditioning frames, which the authors find more temporally coherent than the replacement/imputation method. [@chk-e5abdbd5a133c95ece8bfb33]
